sections.description: REACHRIGHT support chat for site admins, inside the WordPress dashboard: step-by-step answers, Cornerstone and WordPress help guides, Loom video walkthroughs, and a ticket form.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Chat only: no settings page, uploads or database options in WordPress. Everything is managed by REACHRIGHT Studios.
  • Answers come from REACHRIGHT's database, with a built-in backup copy.

1.2.0

  • The chat now appears only in the WordPress dashboard, for logged-in staff.
  • Choose who sees it: administrators only, or editors too.
  • Ticket form is pre-filled with the admin's name, email and site; tickets include site details (WordPress, PHP, theme).
  • Greets admins by name; hidden while editing pages.

1.1.0

  • Updates install from GitHub.
  • Answers can load from Firebase.
  • Loom video walkthroughs.
